headword: {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}
gloss: character (in a story); cast of characters

definitions.gloss: character; dramatis personae; cast of characters
definitions.explanation: A person who appears in a novel, play, film, manga, or other narrative work. Used both for fictional characters and for real people featured in a documentary or biographical work.

examples.japanese: {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}が{多|おお}すぎる。
この{小説|しょうせつ}の{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}はみんな{個性的|こせいてき}だ。
examples.english: All the characters in this novel have distinctive personalities.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}の{中|なか}で、{主人公|しゅじんこう}の{友人|ゆうじん}が{一番|いちばん}{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: Among the characters in the movie, I like the protagonist's friend the most.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard term used in literary criticism, film reviews, and everyday conversation about stories. Often shortened informally to キャラ (character) in casual speech about manga and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}{紹介|しょうかい} (character introduction)
- {主|おも}な{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ} (main characters)
- {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}が{多|おお}い (to have many characters)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- キャラクター: character — loanword, often used in games, anime, and manga
- {主人公|しゅじんこう}: protagonist — the main character specifically
